feeds.title: Teaching Autism Blog
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Nikki, and I'm the face behind Teaching Autism. I have extensive experience working within Special Education, specifically with children diagnosed with Autism. Creating resources that are differentiated and tailored to suit my students is my passion, and I love to make them that extra bit fun too.

feeds.title: Steph's Two Girls
feeds.description: Steph's Two Girls blog follows the life of Steph, a 51-year-old mum of two girls one of whom has autism of a specific type called Pathological Demand Avoidance. Read more about what that means and discover resources, educational insights, and support for autistic persons.

feeds.title: The Autism Page | Blog
feeds.description: Information and resources about autism in relation to young children from one mum to another. Help on supporting your autistic child at home.

feeds.title: Inclusiveteach
feeds.description: Inclusiveteach.com features teaching resources, ideas and articles on the topic of special education, communication and autism.

feeds.title: Autistic and me
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Magda, an autistic blogger based in UK but originally Polish. I'm 44 and was diagnosed with autism when I was 38. On my blog, I make an effort to describe my thought process - everyone says that autistic people think in a different way but no one says how, so I am trying to fill in this gap.

feeds.title: Rainbows Are Too Beautiful
feeds.description: The blog is a place for Ann to share her experiences of life with her autistic and neurotypical kids and an opportunity to promote awareness and greater understanding of autism. The blog also provides light on ADHD, hypermobility, SPD, dyspraxia, anxiety and sleep issues.

feeds.title: The Ringmasters Tale
feeds.description: I'm Helen: Autism advocate, psychotherapist, charity founder, author, public speaker and mum to four amazing children on the autism spectrum. The purpose of my writing is to offer help and advice to anyone who needs it, and to be that reassuring voice I so needed to hear all those years ago when my children were small and my world was filled with endless chaos and universal disapproval.

feeds.title: Autism Berkshire
feeds.description: utism Berkshire was founded as the Berkshire Autistic Society in 1990 by a group of parents of children with autism, related conditions and challenging behaviours.

feeds.title: Autism Parenting Magazine
feeds.description: The magazine features the latest news, tips, and advice for parents of children with Asperger's Syndrome, Kanner's Autism, and PDD-NOS. Covers subjects like: behavioral tips, sensory processing issues, mitigating meltdowns, special education needs, and getting access to services.

feeds.title: Autism Together News
feeds.description: Autism Together provide services for individuals with autism & their families including residential, vocational, supported living, respite, family and work.

feeds.title: Someone's Mum » Autism
feeds.description: Danielle Duggins. Award winning blogger, writer and autism awareness campaigner who has two children, a boy, aged five, (Biggest) who is on the autistic spectrum, and a daughter, aged three.

feeds.title: faithmummy
feeds.description: Life with two children with autism and a mum that believes in miracles. Her journey as a Christian, mum to two very special children and full-time carer.

feeds.title: Undercover Autism
feeds.description: Emma is one of the directors of Autism Wellbeing CIC, a non-profit organization working alongside people to change the way autism is perceived. This blog contains personal insights and the occasional professional reflection. Her current Ph.D. research explores perceptions of autism within community mental health services.

feeds.title: Autism Wellbeing
feeds.description: Autism Wellbeing CIC are a team of professionals working collaboratively with families and individuals affected by autism. Autism Wellbeing's blog is a space for sharing our news and values. We'll keep you updated about our latest projects and share information about the team - including our professional and personal expertise in autism.

feeds.title: Living with a Jude » Autism
feeds.description: A little blog about living with Jude. Jude has learning disabilities so life isn't always as simple as it could be.

feeds.title: Stories About Autism
feeds.description: Stories about everyday life raising two boys with autism. Written from a dad's point of view.

feeds.title: The Autism DaDa
feeds.description: Hi and welcome everyone to a page about me. My name is Sean and I created and write TheAutismDada blog so that I could share my experience of being a dad in an Autism family. What I hope this will do is give you help and answers to questions you may have, things that we may have already gone through as well as, I hope, give you a feeling that you're not alone.
